fragments.html:
ScoutResultRow
ScoutResultRow (private) · Scout/ScoutView.swift
One suggested place: its light and drive, the scout's own note (always labelled), and Open, Save and Add to Trip.
Light-line states
Scored: compact badge and the day. No forecast: 16 pt ring and the short reason (tooltip carries the long reason). Loading: small spinner and "Checking the forecast".

fragments.parentPath: ScoutResultRow/Page/Content/Notes

Never unlabelled
The model's sentence always sits under the "Scout's note" sparkle label. Iter's own facts (light, drive, origin) are never mixed into it.
